title: New link componentIds and version-page strings must be registered together
answers: new componentId lint error model registry link
add componentId to registry for version page link
en.json missing key after adding Source Model label
which files change when adding a UI string in model registry
body:
Invariant: a new Link componentId and any new defaultMessage/description must be added in the same change to two generated or registry files.
- The componentId key (here mlflow.model_registry.version_view.source_model_link, value "") is added to mlflow/server/js/scripts/componentId-registry.js, next to the existing version_view entries.
- Each new intl message (here the 'Source Model' label and the 'Loading source model' screen-reader label) gets a hashed entry in mlflow/server/js/src/lang/default/en.json, keyed by the message ID.
- Both are used by mlflow/server/js/src/model-registry/components/ModelVersionSourceModelLink.tsx and ModelVersionView.tsx. Adding the component without these entries leaves the registry or extraction out of sync.
applies: Any new componentId or user-visible string in mlflow/server/js/src/model-registry.
says: Add a link to the source model on the model version details screen.
The model version page should display a clear label showing its source model.
Screen readers need an announcement when loading the source model for a version.
The source model link on the registered version page shows missing text translations.
Display the originating source model link when viewing a registered model version.
search: Adding a new link componentId or user-visible string in mlflow/server/js/src/model-registry requires simultaneous registration in componentId-registry.js and the default localization dictionary en.json. The componentId key such as mlflow.model_registry.version_view.source_model_link is added to mlflow/server/js/scripts/componentId-registry.js beside version_view entries. New internationalized messages, including the 'Source Model' label and 'Loading source model' screen-reader text, receive hashed entries in mlflow/server/js/src/lang/default/en.json. Both registrations are consumed by ModelVersionSourceModelLink.tsx and ModelVersionView.tsx.
